Around the corner.

intro: Find mapped museums, castles, ruins and attractions across {countries}. Make your next stop worth a look.
empty: No matching sights mapped here. Try another type or a wider radius.
tileError: The map is unavailable. The sights list still works.
footerText: Sights, museums and historic places across {countries}, mapped by the OpenStreetMap community.
howTitle: A little curiosity goes a long way.
how2Text: Browse museums, castles, ruins, monuments and other mapped attractions. Filter by type and entry fee.
how3Text: Check the official website for current opening times and tickets. Open walking directions when you are ready.
DATA_NOT_READY: The sights dataset is not ready yet. Please try again later.
sourceHours: Community map details may be outdated. Check opening times and entry conditions directly with the venue.
openNowHint: Uses mapped opening hours. Unknown or uncertain hours are excluded; opening status does not guarantee ticket availability.
touristDistanceNote: Distances are straight-line distances. Walking routes, elevation gain and terrain can make the journey longer; check a suitable route before setting out.
dataLicense: Location data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Icons: Lucide (ISC).
privacyText: Searches run on this site’s server. We do not store location history. Your language choice is saved only in this browser. OpenStreetMap receives your IP address and the map tiles you view. Google Maps opens only when you choose directions. Names and opening hours come from community map data and may be incomplete. Map labels follow the tile provider’s language.
